- [ASSISTANT_SAID] High Sierra Trail is described as a 72-mile trail running from Giant Forest in Sequoia National Park to Mount Whitney.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested options for section-hiking the High Sierra Trail include:
  1. Giant Forest to Hamilton Lakes (20 miles, 2-3 days)
  2. Hamilton Lakes to Big Arroyo Junction (15 miles, 2 days)

- [USER] User chooses Option 1: Giant Forest to Hamilton Lakes for their hike.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional details for the Giant Forest to Hamilton Lakes section include:
  - Distance: 20 miles (32 km)
  - Elevation Gain: 4,000 feet (1,200 m)
  - Elevation Loss: 1,000 feet (300 m)
  - Highest Point: 10,400 feet (3,170 m) at Hamilton Lakes
  - Trail Type: Out-and-back
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User will need a wilderness permit from Sequoia National
